verified_facts.text: The hotel was originally the private home of an Italian duchess.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally the private home of an Italian duchess, Hotel Esencia is a place where the traditions of the past blend with the cosmopolitan art of living well today.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits where the Yucatan jungle meets the sands of Xpu-Ha bay, one of the remaining undeveloped shores of the Mayan Riviera.
verified_facts.excerpt: This secluded oasis sits where the Yucatán jungle dissolves into the pristine sands of the Xpu-Ha bay, one of the remaining undeveloped shores of the Mayan Riviera.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Esencia is a 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Esencia is a majestic 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen in Mexico.

verified_facts.text: A new owner arrived in 2014, beginning a modern reimagining of the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: A new chapter began in 2014 with the arrival of a new owner and a bold, worldly outlook on how to savor paradise.

verified_facts.text: The Main House is the hotel's centerpiece, with footpaths leading out to the suites and villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Main House remains the hotel’s centerpiece, around which footpaths lead to only 47 suites and 4 villas where guests enjoy genuine privacy and top flight hospitality.

verified_facts.text: Each year sea turtles make their nests in the bay of Xpu-Ha.
verified_facts.excerpt: the immaculate bay of Xpu-Ha is a natural haven where each year sea turtles make their nests.

verified_facts.text: In 2026, for the third year in a row, Hotel Esencia was awarded Three Michelin Keys by the Michelin Guide.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2026, for the third year in a row, Hotel Esencia was the only hotel in the Riviera Maya to be awarded Michelin Guide’s highly coveted Three Michelin Keys.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Esencia holds the Forbes Travel Guide Five Star rating for five consecutive years, 2022 through 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Esencia is also the first and only independent hotel in Mexico to be awarded The Forbes Travel Guide Five Stars, five consecutive years, in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026.
